purpose: Provide fresh, auditable Profile Creator semantic producer executions for Profile Evolution full-behavior benchmarking using any governed GPT/model execution surface; governance is evidence-bound and model/vendor agnostic.
notes: Governed means bound to this contract, exact input/snapshot/source identity, frozen RAW, and explicit no-write/no-activation boundaries; it does not require a dedicated worker process.
GPT is the current semantic executor. Other models may be used later if they satisfy the same contract.
Direct llama-server invocation remains forbidden unless it is itself exposed through a governed execution surface satisfying this contract.
The runner does not authorize profile source writes, runtime activation, production promotion, benchmark admission or cutover.
